item.title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options

turns.text: Give me three different logo options for my cycling club, Moss & Mile. Simple green and black on white, each with the name and a small symbol. Your call on the symbols, but make them genuinely different ideas. Three separate square images please, not a collage.

item.tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

answer_sheet.Exact wording: Moss & Mile on every option, including the ampersand; no extra text.
answer_sheet.Number and delivery: Three separate square images, not one collage or contact sheet.
answer_sheet.Style and palette: Simple cycling-club logos using green and black on white.
answer_sheet.How different the options should be: Three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts, not just recolors of one design.

must_haves: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.

turns.text: Give me three different logo options for my cycling club, Moss & Mile. Simple green and black on white, each with the name and a small symbol. Your call on the symbols, but make them genuinely different ideas. Three separate square images please, not a collage.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the first generation because your account has insufficient credits, so no images were created.

The three distinct directions I planned are:
- **Moss Wheel:** a black bicycle wheel with tiny green moss leaves.
- **Winding Monogram:** a green “M” shaped like a winding road.
- **Leaf Mile Marker:** a black roadside milepost topped with a green leaf.

Each would be a separate square image with **Moss & Mile** on white. You’ll need to add credits before I can generate them.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create ONE polished minimalist vector-style logo for a cycling club named exactly "Moss & Mile". Square image, pure white background. Restrict colors to forest green, black and white; flat colors, no gradients, shadows, textures or mockups. Concept 1: a small elegant bicycle wheel symbol, a thin black circle with a few simple spokes and two tiny forest-green moss leaves growing on its upper left rim. The small symbol sits centered ABOVE the name. Below it, clearly legible exact text "Moss & Mile" in clean bold modern sans-serif black lettering, thoughtfully spaced. Quiet, contemporary cycling club identity. Strong negative space, balanced compact composition with generous white margins, crisp clean geometric edges. Symbol secondary in scale to the name. Only the requested name and one small symbol, no tagline, no other text, no collage, no presentation board.
